readerEvidence.summary: Astra personally read all 42 prepared pages (2 question, 5 solution, 9 answer-sheet, 1 instructions, 25 slideshow pages). Original problem 1 comprises questions 1.1–1.17. Recovered the original projected slideshow, including all sequential star/object markers and slide 10 official correction M16(Aql) to M16(Ser). Printed answer-sheet/key disagreements retained: ecilptic/contellation, repeated C option in 1.15 versus E in key, Ameb/Murzim in key versus Arneb/Mirzam in question, and repeated image-9/stars wording in solution 17. No separate model checker. All 20 final no-snap crops personally viewed after upload. The 25-slide OOXML inventory contains no hidden slides, timing, transitions, audio/video or hyperlinks; all 24 note parts contain no text. Full-slide image crops intentionally preserve sky fields, printed captions, timing and marker order.

transcription.notes: Single top-level task 'Simulated Sky' with 17 sub-questions (1.1–1.17); the actual question texts are on separate Answer Sheets, not in this document. Point values of parts sum to 75, matching the printed total. Page headers read 'Q1-1' (p.1) and 'Q1-2' (p.2), 'English (Official)'.

transcription.verifiedBy: mechanical:textlayer+regions (mechanical check only: schema, text layer, printed figures; no second model, prompt mech-v1)
transcription.notes: The paper prints 17 questions 1.1–1.17 (the catalogue title list shows only 1.1–1.12 but counts 17); each is one problem. The projected planetarium images are not part of the PDFs; the only picture is the sky chart for Image 4 in the solutions (page 2), cropped as p7-sol-fig1. Printed forms kept verbatim: "at what time?." and "projected sky?." (punctuation), "option that contain" in 1.11 (agreement error kept as printed per D-P28, also in the solutions), "here We have it" (capital W), "$-30$ of latitude"/"$-74$ longitude" without degree signs in the problem sheet, "$(74^{\circ} E)$on" without a space, the second option label "C." for the last choice of 1.15 (solutions label it E.), the unbalanced parenthesis "(Image 5, for questions 11 and 12." in the solutions. In the solutions 16 the star names are printed "Ameb" and "Murzim" where the problem table has "Arneb" and "Mirzam"; names are never changed, kept as printed. The solution of 17 repeats the wording of 16 ("Several stars have been indicated in image 9...") although the question is about Messier objects in image 10; kept as printed. Solution highlights (red/orange) of correct options are rendered as bold; check marks as ✓. In 1.14 the problem sheet prints "Wich object is this?"; kept as printed (the checker treats "Wich" as a word); the solutions print "Which".

slideshow.staticLimitations: The original projected slides are reproduced as static images in their source order. Their printed time limits and sequential star/object markers are retained; the page does not replay the timed presentation.

warningDisposition: 17 source subquestions are represented by 17 native sections, not lost in statement text.
